Hi Marta,

Thanks for reaching out. When an order is placed, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. For a day or two, a pending authorization and a settled charge can both show up, which can look like a double charge. Pending authorizations drop off automatically within five business days.

If the two 74.50 charges are still showing after that, or if they don't match an order in your account, please reply with the order details, the amounts, and the dates, and our team will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for reaching out. You can download an invoice for any order from the Orders page in your account, so order 49001 should be available there. Receipts are also emailed to you when the order ships.

If the invoice doesn't show the itemized detail your company needs, a member of our support team will follow up with you directly.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Amelia,

Sorry to hear you can't get into your account. Our help article covers changing your email address from Account settings and merging duplicate accounts, but it doesn't cover login errors, so a specialist will follow up with you about this.

In the meantime, please make sure you're using the email address the account was created with, and that you have the exact password you set. If you have a second account, let us know its email address too.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ravi,

Thanks for reaching out. Unfortunately, our help article does not cover recovering access when an authenticator app is lost, so I can't give you steps for that here. A specialist will follow up with you to look into your sign-in options.

If you have two accounts or need to change the email address on your account, our Account settings page covers those options, and the article describes how merging and email changes work.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Lucía,

Thanks for reaching out about order 49087, and I'm sorry it's taken this long to arrive.

You can check the status on the Orders page of your account. Once the package leaves our warehouse, the order will show a carrier name and tracking number. If the carrier's tracking page hasn't updated for more than three business days, the package may be delayed at a carrier hub, and we can open a trace with the carrier, which usually resolves within five business days.

I don't have the specific status of your order in this message, so a member of our support team will follow up with you about it.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Owen,

Thanks for reaching out. I'm not able to give a delivery date to Vancouver from the information I have. Our order tracking guide explains that orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave the warehouse that same day, and orders placed later or on weekends leave the next business day. Once your package ships, you'll see the carrier name and tracking number on the Orders page of your account, and the carrier's tracking page updates within 24 hours of the first scan. For the estimated arrival time for the faster shipping option, a specialist will follow up with you.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Hana,

Sorry your order arrived with the wrong item. I'm not able to confirm how we'll resolve this, since our refund policy doesn't cover wrong-item deliveries. A support specialist will follow up with you about the next steps for the women's medium fleece.

If you have your order number handy, please include it in your reply so the specialist can find your order quickly.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Karim,

Thanks for reaching out. Refunds go to your original payment method within five business days after the return arrives at our warehouse. After that, your bank may take a further three to ten business days to show the credit on your statement.

Since the carrier delivered your return about two weeks ago, the refund may still be processing or may be pending on your bank's side. If more than 15 business days have passed since delivery and no refund has appeared, please reply with your order number and we will check the return with our warehouse. A specialist will follow up if needed.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Beatriz,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry to hear your Summit 2 tent pole cracked during setup. Our product care guidance covers washing, re-proofing, and storing gear, but it doesn't address pole damage or warranty coverage for breakage, so I can't confirm what options are available for your tent.

A specialist will follow up with you about the cracked pole and your June purchase. Please keep your proof of purchase handy when they reach out.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Felix,

Thanks for reaching out. When a shell stops beading water, the waterproof coating has likely worn down with use. Our care guidance suggests washing the jacket with a technical-fabric wash (not regular detergent), then applying a spray-on re-proofing treatment. This can restore the coating, and it does not affect the warranty.

Please also make sure the jacket is dried on low heat, since heat helps the treatment bond.

If the jacket still soaks through after washing and re-proofing, a specialist will follow up with you to look into it further.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out. Unfortunately, our order tracking information doesn't cover shipping destinations, so I can't confirm whether we ship to APO addresses. A support specialist will follow up with you on this question.

In the meantime, you can check your order status anytime from the Orders page of your account. Once a package leaves our warehouse, you'll see the carrier name and tracking number there.

Best regards,
Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Chiara,

Thanks for reaching out. Our billing information doesn't cover discount codes, so I can't confirm why SUMMER15 didn't apply or whether it can be added to an order after it's placed. A support specialist will follow up with you on this.

In the meantime, you can find your order details and invoices on the Orders page in your account.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Mohammed,

Yes, we can merge accounts that were created by accident. To do this, please reply with the email addresses of both accounts and tell us which one you'd like to keep. Once we have that, the merge takes one business day, and all orders and rewards points will appear in one place.

Thank you for reaching out.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Grace,

Thanks for reaching out. Our article covers tracking, but it doesn't explain how to change a shipping address on an order that's already placed, so I can't confirm whether that's possible for yesterday's order. A specialist will follow up with you on that.

What I can tell you: orders placed before 2 pm on a business day leave our warehouse the same day, and later orders or weekend orders leave the next business day. Once your package ships, you can follow it from the Orders page in your account, where the carrier and tracking number will appear.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Pablo,

Thanks for reaching out. Flat, clumpy down after a wash is a common concern, and it may be fixable. Our care guidance recommends washing down jackets on a gentle cycle with a technical-fabric wash (not regular detergent) and tumble drying on low. Adding two or three clean tennis balls to the dryer helps restore loft. If the jacket was dried on a higher heat or without the tennis balls, that could be part of the issue.

Whether the down can be fully restored in your case isn't something I can confirm from this information, so a member of our support team will follow up with you directly.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Yasmin,

Thanks for reaching out. You can return an unworn item with its tags attached within 60 days of delivery. Start the return from the Orders page, select only the item you want to send back, and print the prepaid return label.

For refunds, a flat $7 label fee is deducted unless the item arrived damaged or we sent the wrong item. Please note that items marked final sale, or safety equipment like climbing hardware once opened, can't be returned.

If you have questions about your specific order, a specialist will follow up.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Tom,

Thanks for reaching out. A pending authorization can remain on a card for a day or two after an order is placed, and it drops off automatically within five business days. Our records don't show anything beyond that for your cancelled order, so we can't confirm the exact status of this authorization from the information available here. If the pending amount is still showing after five business days, or if you see a settled charge for the cancelled order, please reply with the amount and date and a specialist will follow up to investigate.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Aiko,

Thanks for reaching out. Our refund timeline information covers when store credit appears in your account, which is usually the same day the return is checked in. It does not address whether store credit expires, so I'm not able to confirm that from the information I have. A member of our support team will follow up with you about the expiry date for your store credit.

Fernwood Outfitters Support

Hi Ben,

Thanks for reaching out about your trekking pole tip. I'm sorry the carbide tip came off during your second hike.

Our product care information covers washing, re-proofing, and storing shells, down, and sleeping bags, but it doesn't address warranty coverage for trekking pole parts. I don't want to guess at what's covered, so a specialist will follow up with you about whether this falls under warranty and what the next steps would be.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
